premises.text: Women can choose the price they want to pay for coveted handbags and accessories.
premises.evidence_span: we allow women to choose the price they want to pay for the most coveted handbags and accessories

premises.text: The platform focuses on in-season merchandise and uses a game-like element to create demand.
premises.evidence_span: we actually focus on in-season merchandise while using a game-like element to build buzz and create new demands

premises.text: Members can purchase credits to participate in sales.
premises.evidence_span: she must first purchase to buy for credit. A single credit costs 99 cents.

premises.text: The price of items drops as more members join the sale.
premises.evidence_span: the price will drop lower every second. In fact, it drops faster as more and more members join the sale.

premises.text: Brands benefit from cost-effective marketing techniques through the platform.
premises.evidence_span: brands get one of those cost-effective marketing techniques in years.

premises.text: The business model includes collecting markups on merchandise and entrance fees.
premises.evidence_span: we make money in two ways. First, we collect the markup between the wholesale cost of an item and its final sale price on the site. Second, we collect entrance fees from each player.

premises.text: The platform can achieve higher gross margins than traditional retailers.
premises.evidence_span: this results in a gross margin of about 60%, significantly higher than the 35% to 40% average gross margin at traditional retailers.

premises.text: The platform can attract users through targeted advertising and viral marketing.
premises.evidence_span: we actually end up spending far less per user on both our pay-per-click and our SEO work. Also, fashion plays like this tend to be highly viral.

premises.text: The platform differentiates itself by allowing in-season merchandise to be sold at a discount.
premises.evidence_span: we found a way to differentiate ourselves in this space.

premises.text: Luxury brands can create buzz around their merchandise through the platform.
premises.evidence_span: we offer luxury brands a similar value proposition by helping to create buzz around their in-season merchandise.

value.text: Women gain access to coveted handbags and accessories at prices they choose.
value.evidence_span: women to choose the price they want to pay for the most coveted handbags and accessories
